issues.summary: Bind client certificate CN to requested system_id before serving DHCP data
issues.detail: RequireClientCertMiddleware only checks that a client cert is present and stores the agent UUID in request.scope["client_cn"]; nothing compares it to the {system_id} path parameter (agent.py:209-215). Any enrolled agent can read any rack's full DHCP topology (subnets, pools, host reservations with MAC/IP/hostname, gateways, DNS/NTP, Kea HA peer IPs). Reviewers suggest resolving the agent from the CN and 403-ing on mismatch; claude-opus-5 also notes the sibling routes key on agent {uuid} while this route keys on the rack node system_id, so the expected identifier should be made explicit.

issues.summary: Response model ties wire contract to service-layer dataclasses with silent drift
issues.detail: AgentDHCPDataResponse both embeds the maasservicelayer stdlib dataclasses (VlanData, SubnetData, etc.) as field types and re-declares DHCPDataForAgent's seven fields 1:1 in from_model (responses/agent.py:71-95). A field rename in the DTOs silently changes the agent-facing JSON schema, and a field added to DHCPDataForAgent is silently dropped from the response with no test failure; reviewers suggest dedicated Pydantic response models, nesting the payload, or deriving/asserting the field set.

issues.summary: Endpoint has no consumer; Go agent still uses legacy DHCP config path
issues.detail: The Go agent client (src/maasagent/internal/client/client.go, src/maasagent/internal/dhcp/service.go:670) still calls /agents/{system_id}/services/dhcp/config proxied through the legacy Django API. Until the agent side lands this endpoint is unreachable code; if it is meant to replace the legacy path the commit body should say so.

issues.summary: Query-heavy endpoint lacks conditional GET or per-caller guard against fan-out
issues.detail: get_kea_dhcp_data_for_agent runs a long chain of DB queries (vlans, relay vlans, subnets, ipranges, interfaces, reserved/static IPs, domains; maasservicelayer/services/dhcp.py:118-405). With no caller binding and no ETag/conditional GET (unlike sibling get_agent_config), a misbehaving or hostile agent can repeatedly drive the full query set for every rack (agent.py:212).

Out of diff scope but in the touched file: AgentConfigResponse.kind at responses/agent.py:45 defaults to "AgentSignedCertificate", an apparent copy-paste from AgentSignedCertificateResponse; it should default to "AgentConfig". Worth fixing while editing this file.

issues.summary: Declare 403 response so the OpenAPI documents the middleware rejection
issues.detail: RequireClientCertMiddleware returns 403 with a bare {"detail": ...} body for requests without a client CN, but 403 is absent from the handler's documented responses (agent.py:200-207) even though ForbiddenBodyResponse exists; the sibling /agents/{uuid}/config has the same gap. Declaring it would make the generated OpenAPI accurate for agent clients.

issues.summary: Drop redundant 422 response entry and its import
issues.detail: handler() unconditionally injects {422: ValidationErrorBodyResponse} whenever responses is set (src/maasapiserver/common/api/base.py:35-40), so the explicit 422 entry (agent.py:203) is overwritten by an identical one and the ValidationErrorBodyResponse import (agent.py:15) is dead weight.

issues.summary: 404/422 tests assert only status codes, exercising generic exception mapping
issues.detail: test_agent_dhcp_data_404 and test_agent_dhcp_data_422_when_rack_not_configured only assert the status code, which tests ExceptionMiddleware's generic exception->status mapping rather than handler logic. glm reviewers ask to also assert the error body shape and details (e.g. details[0]["message"] == "The rack controller has no current configuration.") as neighboring 404/503 tests do; claude-opus-5 would keep just one propagation test and instead test the proposed caller/system_id authorization check.

issues.summary: Delete vacuous 403 test that never reaches the endpoint
issues.detail: test_agent_dhcp_data_requires_client_certificate (test_agent.py:368) does not exercise the new endpoint: RequireClientCertMiddleware short-circuits before routing, so the test passes for any URL including a nonexistent one and assert_not_called() is vacuous. The behavior is already covered by src/tests/maasapiserver/v3/middlewares/test_client_certificate.py.

issues.summary: Assert the ipranges field in the endpoint or response-model tests
issues.detail: ipranges is populated in DHCP_DATA and is part of AgentDHCPDataResponse, but neither test_agent_dhcp_data_200 nor the response-model test asserts it, so a copy mistake in from_model would pass unnoticed (test_agent.py:340).

issues.summary: Replace module-level DHCP_DATA constant with a shared fresh-instance factory
issues.detail: DHCP_DATA is a ~60-line module-level mutable dataclass graph in the handler test file (test_agent.py:87) and is duplicated in the response-model test file (responses/test_agent.py:44). A future test mutating it leaks into others; a shared fixture/builder returning a fresh instance would fix both the mutability risk and the duplication.

issues.summary: Drop response-model test whose field-copy assertions the 200 test subsumes
issues.detail: TestAgentDHCPDataResponse.test_from_model (responses/test_agent.py:42) only asserts field copies (response.vlans == dhcp_data.vlans, etc.), fully subsumed by test_agent_dhcp_data_200 which additionally proves JSON serialization; per repo guidance to avoid trivial assertions it should be deleted.

issues.summary: Merge the two near-duplicate TLS test middlewares
issues.detail: InjectTLSWithoutClientCert (test_agent.py:161) duplicates InjectFakeTLSCN except for the tls dict contents; a single middleware taking a client_cn parameter (e.g. add_middleware(InjectFakeTLSCN, client_cn=None)) would cover both with-cert and without-cert cases.

issues.summary: Wrap self_base_hyperlink line exceeding the 79-char limit
issues.detail: The self_base_hyperlink argument line in get_agent_dhcp_data (agent.py:215) is 89 characters, exceeding the 79-char width configured in pyproject.toml; E501 is ignored by ruff but the project convention requires 79 chars.

In AgentDHCPDataResponse.from_model (responses/agent.py:94) the f-string wrapper in f"{self_base_hyperlink.rstrip('/')}" does nothing; the plain expression suffices. The same pattern was copied from AgentConfigResponse and both could be cleaned up.
